discovery.reason: stage begins on or before the fixed historical-exposure cutoff

confirmation.reason: stage begins on or before the fixed historical-exposure cutoff

locked_holdout.reason: stage begins on or before the fixed historical-exposure cutoff

primary_metrics: paired daily rank_ic difference versus the unchanged Alpha158 baseline
paired daily 10 bps stress raw-share strategy_net difference versus the unchanged Alpha158 baseline
statistics.metric_session_semantics: signal date T only; the following label_horizon_bars sessions may be read only to mature T's forward label
statistics.family_ablations: screening evidence only; no standalone confirmation claim
statistics.terminal_rule: candidate terminal account must not lose absolute capital, must improve versus baseline, and must beat SH510300 at 10 bps stress
statistics.robustness_rule: 10 bps cash-reset 21-signal-session folds, 25 percent maximum drawdown, and frozen instrument/fold contribution concentration limits

stage_policy.discovery: Screen only on discovery sessions; freeze one candidate specification afterward.
stage_policy.confirmation: Evaluate the frozen specification once on confirmation sessions without retuning.
stage_policy.locked_holdout: Evaluate the same frozen specification once only after confirmation passes.
stage_policy.one_shot_ledger: A claimed stage is consumed even when evaluation fails.

limitations: No experiment, statistical result, or improvement is represented by this plan.
Evidence remains research-only while the ETF universe is not point-in-time.
Multiple-testing control does not repair data leakage, survivorship bias, or execution-model error.
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control relies on its standard dependence conditions across factor tests.
Dates on or before the fixed exposure cutoff are retrospective_exposed and can never support an unseen, pristine, blind, or promotion claim.
